spec.description: Allocated share per pool from `zpool list`, via the zfs_zpool textfile collector. This is the pool-level number; the filesystem panels above count datasets and quotas. Keep pools under 80 percent, ZFS gets slow and fragmented beyond that.
spec.title: Pool capacity (zpool)

spec.description: Free-space fragmentation per pool in percent (`zpool list -o frag`). Rises with age and fill level; above 50 writes get noticeably slower. The only cure is free space or a rebuild.
spec.title: Pool fragmentation

spec.description: Allocated bytes per pool over time (size minus free), with the pool size dashed. Growth rate tells you when the pool fills up.
spec.title: Pool allocated vs size

spec.description: Top 15 datasets by used bytes (`zfs list -o used`), including snapshots and children. Subvol and vm disks of the Proxmox guests dominate.
spec.title: Largest datasets

spec.description: Used bytes of the ten largest selected datasets over time.
spec.title: Dataset growth
